meanings.usage: 可表示自然流动的事物或社会发展的动向

meanings.meaning: 流通的（在本文中与account搭配指活期账户，可随时存取款项） noun. 水流

meanings.usage: 是动词repay的名词形式，后常接of sth表示对某物的偿还

meanings.meaning: 借方（与creditor（债权人）相对，指欠别人钱的一方）

meanings.usage: 指有权要求他人偿还欠款的一方
常用被动形式be overdrawn表示账户处于透支状态
常接to sb/sth表示对某人/某事物的义务，owe obligation to sb表示对某人负有义务
指让原本的问题变得更难处理的额外状况

meanings.meaning: 从（账户）中扣除（常用结构debit sth against/to sb's account，表示将某笔款项记入账户借方） noun. 借方
借记（与credit（贷方）相对，是会计常用术语）

meanings.usage: 可指用于检验、参考的各类样品，本文指签字样本
可指伪造文件、签名等，也可指金属锻造工艺
是forge的名词形式，可指伪造的行为或伪造出来的物品
主语通常为事物，强调让某件事更容易进行

phrases.usage: 银行术语，指可随时存取款、用于日常支付的活期存款账户，美语中常用checking account表示相同含义

examples.en: I need to open a current account to pay my monthly bills.
examples.zh: 我需要开一个活期账户来支付我的每月账单。

phrases.usage: 表示“以……为收款人；有利于；支持”，在金融场景中常指支票的收款方

examples.en: Please draw a cheque in favour of the charity organization.
examples.zh: 请开一张以该慈善机构为收款人的支票。

phrases.usage: 银行账户用语，表示账户有余额、处于贷方余额状态，与be overdrawn（透支）相对

examples.en: Your account is still in credit, so you don't need to deposit more money right now.
examples.zh: 你的账户还有余额，所以你现在不需要再存钱。

phrases.usage: 正式表达，意为“引起；导致；使发生”，后接表示问题、变化等的名词

examples.en: Poor communication may give rise to misunderstandings between team members.
examples.zh: 沟通不畅可能会引起团队成员之间的误解。

phrases.usage: 表示“对……不利；偏向于反对……”，常用来描述规则、制度等不公平地偏向某一方

examples.en: Many workers complain that the existing labour law is loaded against them.
examples.zh: 许多工人抱怨现行的劳动法对他们不利。

phrases.usage: 正式用语，意为“关于；涉及；就……而言”，用于引出相关的对象或范围

examples.en: The company will compensate you in respect of the losses caused by the delay.
examples.zh: 公司将就延误给你造成的损失进行赔偿。

phrases.usage: 表示“没有影响；无关紧要”，后可接that从句或疑问词引导的从句说明具体内容

examples.en: It makes no difference how much experience you have - we will all receive the same training.
examples.zh: 你有多少经验都无关紧要，我们都会接受同样的培训。

grammar.title: 独立主格结构
grammar.structure: 名词/代词 + 现在分词/过去分词/形容词/副词/介词短语
grammar.definition: 由名词/代词 + 非谓语动词/形容词/副词/介词短语等构成，在句中作状语，其逻辑主语与句子主句的主语不一致，有独立的逻辑主语 常用于书面语中，可表示时间、原因、条件、伴随状况等，相当于一个状语从句

examples.en: who is which depending on whether the customer's account is in credit or is overdrawn.
examples.zh: 谁是债务人谁是债权人取决于客户的账户是有余额还是透支。

examples.en: The weather being fine, we decided to go hiking in the mountains.
examples.zh: 天气很好，我们决定去山里徒步旅行。

grammar.title: It作形式主语的主语从句
grammar.structure: It + 系动词/不及物动词 + 形容词/名词/短语 + that/wh-引导的主语从句
grammar.definition: 当主语是较长的从句时，为了避免句子头重脚轻，通常用it作形式主语放在句首，而把真正的主语从句放到句子后面 常用于表达事实、观点、可能性等，使句子结构更平衡

examples.en: It makes no difference that the forgery may have been a very skillful one.
examples.zh: 伪造的技术可能非常高超，这也没有用。

examples.en: It is obvious that regular exercise is beneficial to physical and mental health.
examples.zh: 很明显，规律锻炼对身心健康有益。

grammar.title: 强调句
grammar.structure: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其他部分
grammar.definition: 用来突出句子中的某一部分（通常是主语、宾语、状语），强调该部分的重要性 当被强调部分指人时可以用who，其他情况一律用that，去掉It is/was和that/who后句子依然完整

examples.en: If this facilitates forgery, it is the bank which will lose, not the customer.
examples.zh: 如果这种做法便利了伪造，那么受损失的会是银行，而不是客户。

examples.en: It was his hard work rather than luck that helped him achieve success.
examples.zh: 是他的努力而非运气帮助他取得了成功。

patterns.pattern: Primarily, A is that of B-- X depending on whether Y or Z.

original.en: Primarily, the banker-customer relationship is that of debtor and creditor-- who is which depending on whether the customer's account is in credit or is overdrawn.
original.zh: 银行与客户的关系主要是债务人和债权人的关系——谁是债务人谁是债权人取决于客户的账户是有余额还是透支。

imitations.en: Primarily, the teacher-student relationship is that of guider and learner-- what role each plays depending on whether the class is theory-based or practice-based.
imitations.zh: 师生关系主要是指导者和学习者的关系——各自扮演什么角色取决于课程是理论型还是实践型。

imitations.en: Primarily, the relationship between sellers and buyers is that of service provider and consumer-- who holds more initiative depending on whether the market is a buyer's market or a seller's market.
imitations.zh: 买卖双方的关系主要是服务提供者和消费者的关系——谁更有主动权取决于市场是买方市场还是卖方市场。

patterns.pattern: There is a very firm rule that A has no right or authority to do B on C.

original.en: there is a very firm rule that the bank has no right or authority to pay out a customer's money on a cheque on which its customer's signature has been forged.
original.zh: 有一条非常严格的规定：银行没有权利或权限凭客户签名被伪造的支票支付客户的存款。

imitations.en: There is a very firm rule in the company that managers have no right or authority to ask employees to work overtime without extra pay.
imitations.zh: 公司有一条非常严格的规定：管理者没有权利或权限要求员工无偿加班。

imitations.en: There is a very firm rule in the school that teachers have no right or authority to punish students physically on any ground.
imitations.zh: 学校有一条非常严格的规定：教师没有权利或权限以任何理由体罚学生。

patterns.pattern: For this reason there is no risk to A in the practice, adopted by B, of doing C.

original.en: For this reason there is no risk to the customer in the practice, adopted by banks, of printing the customer's name on his cheques.
original.zh: 因此，银行采取的把客户姓名印在支票上的做法对客户没有任何风险。

imitations.en: For this reason there is no risk to consumers in the practice, adopted by the platform, of freezing transactions until the goods are confirmed received.
imitations.zh: 因此，平台采取的在确认收货前冻结交易的做法对消费者没有任何风险。

imitations.en: For this reason there is no risk to passengers in the practice, adopted by airlines, of checking the validity of ID documents before boarding.
imitations.zh: 因此，航空公司采取的登机前检查身份证件有效性的做法对乘客没有任何风险。

lines.en: When anyone opens a current account at a bank, he is lending the bank money, repayment of which he may demand at any time, either in cash or by drawing a cheque in favour of another person.
lines.zh: 任何人在银行开一个活期账户，就等于把钱借给了银行。这笔钱他可以随时提取，提取的方式可以是取现金，也可以是开一张以他人为收款人的支票。

lines.en: Primarily, the banker-customer relationship is that of debtor and creditor -- who is which depending on whether the customer's account is in credit or is overdrawn .
lines.zh: 银行与储户的关系主要是债务人和债权人的关系。

lines.en: But, in addition to that basically simple concept, the bank and its customer owe a large number of obligations to one another.
lines.zh: 究竟谁是债务人谁是债权人，要看储户是有结余还是透支。

lines.en: Many of these obligations can give in to problems and complications but a bank customer, unlike, say, a buyer of goods, cannot complain that the law is loaded against him.
lines.zh: 除了这一基本的简单的概念外，银行和储户彼此还需承担大量义务。其中许多义务往往引起问题和纠纷。

lines.en: The bank must obey its customer's instructions, and not those of anyone else.
lines.zh: 但是储户不能像货物的买主那样来抱怨法律对自己不利。

lines.en: When, for example, a customer first opens an account, he instructs the bank to debit his account only in respect of cheques draw by himself.
lines.zh: 银行必须遵照储户的嘱托办事，不能听从其他人的指令。

lines.en: He gives the bank specimens of his signature, and there is a very firm rule that the bank has no right or authority to pay out a customer's money on a cheques on which its customer's signature has been forged.
lines.zh: 比如，储户首次在银行开户时，嘱咐银行他的存款只能凭本世人签字的支票来提取。

lines.en: It makes no difference that the forgery may have been a very skilful one: the bank must recognize its customer's signature.
lines.zh: 他把自己签名的样本交给银行，对此有一条非常严格的规定：银行没有任何权利或理由把储户的钱让伪造储户的支票取走。

lines.en: For this reason there is no risk to the customer in the practice, adopted by banks, of printing the customer's name on his cheques.
lines.zh: 即使伪造得很巧妙，也不能付款，因为银行有责任辨认出其储户的签名。

lines.en: If this facilitates forgery, it is the bank which will lose, not the customer.
lines.zh: 因此，某些银行已采用把储户印在支票上的作法。
这种做法对储户毫无风险。

lines.en: DLAMOND The Consumer Society and the Law
lines.zh: 如果因这种作法出现了伪造的话，受损失的将不是储户，而是银行。

questions.q: Why is there no risk to the customer when a bank prints the customer's name on his cheques?
questions.zh: 当银行把顾客的姓名印在他的支票上时，为什么顾客毫无风险？
questions.a: Because the bank must recognize its customer's signature and has no right or authority to pay out a customer's money on a cheque on which the signature has been forged; if printing the name facilitates forgery, it is the bank that will lose, not the customer.
questions.aZh: 因为辨认储户签名是银行的责任，银行无权凭一张签名被伪造的支票把储户的钱付出去；如果印姓名反而方便了伪造，受损失的是银行，而不是顾客。
questions.hint: 答案在课文最后两句，点明“辨认签名是银行责任、损失归银行”。

questions.q: What is the primary relationship between the banker and the customer?
questions.zh: 银行与储户之间的主要关系是什么？
questions.aZh: 债务人和债权人的关系。
questions.hint: 课文第二句直接给出：debtor and creditor。

questions.q: What does a customer instruct the bank to do when he first opens an account?
questions.zh: 储户首次开户时，嘱咐银行做什么？
questions.a: He instructs the bank to debit his account only in respect of cheques drawn by himself.
questions.aZh: 他嘱咐银行只能凭他本人签发的支票从他的账户中付款。
questions.hint: 见课文“he instructs the bank to debit his account only in respect of cheques drawn by himself”。

questions.q: What is the firm rule concerning a cheque with a forged signature?
questions.zh: 关于签名被伪造的支票，那条严格规定是什么？
questions.a: The bank has no right or authority to pay out a customer's money on a cheque on which its customer's signature has been forged.
questions.aZh: 银行没有任何权利或理由，凭一张伪造了储户签名的支票把储户的钱付出去。
questions.hint: 课文“there is a very firm rule that ...”一句。

questions.q: Why does the customer take no risk if a bank prints his name on his cheques?
questions.zh: 如果银行把顾客姓名印在支票上，为什么顾客不承担风险？
questions.a: Because the bank must recognize its customer's signature; if printing the name facilitates forgery, it is the bank that will lose, not the customer.
questions.aZh: 因为认准签名是银行的责任；即便印姓名方便了伪造，受损失的是银行，而不是顾客。
questions.hint: 综合课文“the bank must recognize its customer's signature”与末句“it is the bank which will lose”作答。

translation:
任何人在银行开一个活期账户，就等于把钱借给了银行。
这笔钱他可以随时提取，提取的方式可以是取现金，也可以是开一张以他人为收款人的支票。
银行与储户的关系主要是债务人和债权人的关系。
究竟谁是债务人谁是债权人，要看储户是有结余还是透支。
除了这一基本的简单的概念外，银行和储户彼此还需承担大量义务。
其中许多义务往往引起问题和纠纷。
但是储户不能像货物的买主那样来抱怨法律对自己不利。
银行必须遵照储户的嘱托办事，不能听从其他人的指令。
比如，储户首次在银行开户时，嘱咐银行他的存款只能凭本世人签字的支票来提取。
他把自己签名的样本交给银行，对此有一条非常严格的规定：银行没有任何权利或理由把储户的钱让伪造储户的支票取走。
即使伪造得很巧妙，也不能付款，因为银行有责任辨认出其储户的签名。
因此，某些银行已采用把储户印在支票上的作法。
这种做法对储户毫无风险。
如果因这种作法出现了伪造的话，受损失的将不是储户，而是银行。
title: Banks and Their Customers
subtitle: 银行与顾客

lead.question: 银行为什么必须辨认储户的签名？把顾客姓名印在支票上，储户为何反而没有风险？
lead.warmup: 在日常生活里，我们几乎都要和银行打交道：开账户、存钱、取现、签支票。可你是否想过，当你把钱存进银行，法律上你其实成了债权人，银行反倒成了债务人？本课从“活期账户”说起，带你弄清银行与顾客之间那一大堆看不见的义务，尤其是一条关键规定：银行只能认储户本人的签名，认错就得自己承担损失。
goals: 掌握 current account、debtor、creditor、deposit、draw a cheque、in favour of 等银行业核心词汇。
理清银行与顾客之间债务人和债权人的关系，以及双方各自承担的义务。
掌握被动语态与含介词的定语从句（a cheque on which ...）的用法。
能就“伪造签名”这一情形说明银行为何须辨认签名、为何损失由银行承担。
lead.summary: 课文指出，顾客在银行开立活期账户，实际上是把钱借给银行，二者的基本关系是债务人与债权人。除这一简单概念外，双方还互负大量义务：银行必须只服从顾客本人的指令，认准其签名样本，无权凭伪造签名的支票付款。正因为辨认签名是银行的责任，即使把顾客姓名印在支票上方便了伪造，受损失的也是银行，而不是顾客。
lead.tips: in favour of 在此意为“以……为收款人”，不要理解成“赞成”；draw a cheque 是“开、签支票”，注意 draw 的过去式是 drew、过去分词是 drawn，课文用的是被动的 drawn。

exercises.q: 填空：When anyone opens a current ______ at a bank, he is lending the bank money.
汉译英：任何人在银行开一个活期账户，就等于把钱借给了银行。
exercises.a: When anyone opens a current account at a bank, he is lending the bank money.
exercises.note: “借给某人某物”用 lend sb sth。

exercises.q: 句型转换（改为被动语态）：The bank must recognize its customer's signature.
exercises.a: Its customer's signature must be recognized by the bank.
exercises.note: 情态动词被动：must be done。

exercises.q: 改错：It makes no difference that the forgery may has been a very skilful one.
exercises.a: It makes no difference that the forgery may have been a very skilful one.
exercises.note: 情态动词后须接动词原形 have。

exercises.q: 填空：Primarily, the banker-customer relationship is that of ______ and creditor.
exercises.note: 与 creditor 相对的债务人为 debtor。

exercises.q: 合并为定语从句（用 on which）：The bank has no right to pay out the money on a cheque. Its customer's signature has been forged on it.
exercises.a: The bank has no right to pay out the money on a cheque on which its customer's signature has been forged.
exercises.note: 介词 on 提前，用 on which 引导。

exercises.q: 汉译英：如果因这种做法出现了伪造，受损失的将不是储户，而是银行。
exercises.a: If this facilitates forgery, it is the bank which will lose, not the customer.
exercises.note: 强调句型 it is ... which ...，注意 not the customer。

quiz.q: 课文认为，银行与储户之间的关系主要是哪一种？
options: Debtor and creditor
Landlord and tenant
Employer and employee
Buyer and seller
quiz.note: 第二句点明债务人与债权人。

quiz.q: 顾客在银行开立活期账户，法律上等于做了什么？
options: Borrowing money from the bank
Lending the bank money
Buying shares of the bank
Depositing money for the bank to keep
quiz.note: 开活期账户即借钱给银行。

quiz.q: 按照课文，这笔钱他可以怎样随时提取？
options: Only in cash
Only by drawing a cheque
Either in cash or by drawing a cheque
Only through a third person
quiz.note: 取现金或开以他人为收款人的支票。

quiz.q: 关于签名被伪造的支票，那条很严格的规定是什么？
options: The bank must still pay if the forgery is very skilful.
The bank has no right or authority to pay out the customer's money.
The customer must report it to the police at once.
The loss is shared equally by both sides.
quiz.note: 银行无权凭伪造签名的支票付款。

quiz.q: 银行必须遵照谁的指令办事？
options: Those of anyone who holds the cheque
Those of its customer, and not those of anyone else
Those of the government
Those of the person named on the cheque
quiz.note: 只服从顾客本人的指令。

quiz.q: 如果银行把顾客姓名印在支票上，结果会怎样？
options: The customer bears all the risk.
Both the bank and the customer lose.
It is the bank which will lose, not the customer.
Nobody suffers any loss.
